help_subtitle: How can we help you today?
faq_notifications_answer:
To receive notifications:
1. Go to iOS Settings > M1SSION > Notifications
2. Enable "Allow Notifications"
3. Make sure "Do Not Disturb" mode is off
4. Restart the app

If the problem persists, try reinstalling the app.
faq_confused_question: I don't know what to do now
faq_confused_answer:
M1SSION guides you through daily missions. To start:
1. Check the "Next Action" container on Home
2. Complete the daily commit (the 3 blobs)
3. Explore the map to find clues
4. Use AION for smart suggestions

Every action brings you closer to the final prize!
faq_rewards_answer:
M1U (M1 Units) are M1SSION's currency:
• Earn M1U by completing actions
• Use M1U to unlock premium clues
• You can buy M1U in the Shop

Prizes are awarded to top agents on the leaderboard. Check your position in real time!
faq_access_answer:
If you have trouble logging in:
1. Check your internet connection
2. Try logging out and back in
3. If you forgot your password, use "Forgot Password"
4. Make sure your email is correct

For persistent issues, contact AION.
faq_bug_answer:
If you encounter an error:
1. Restart the app
2. Make sure you have the latest version
3. Clear the cache (Settings > M1SSION > Clear cache)

To report a bug, talk to AION describing the problem and when it occurs.
